messages:
rachel (design): quick follow-up from user testing — when filters reduce the rules list to zero, people don't know whether the editor failed or they just filtered too much. want to ship a small nudge card that explains why and offers next steps. dan (product): agree. prefer action-first copy. proposal: 'No rules to show. You have filters applied: service=payments, env=staging.' actions: primary 'Create rule' secondary 'Clear filters'. add a tiny 'Learn more' link to docs. julio (frontend): implementation note: don't remove the list container entirely — keep a reserved min-height (3 rows) to avoid scrollbar jumps. render a compact inline card with a 16px icon, no big illustrations. also will add a small telemetry event when user clicks 'Clear filters' or 'Create rule'. meera (a11y): accessibility checklist: - announce the zero-state via a polite live region: "0 rules match. filters: service=payments" only when the count actually changes (debounce 300ms). - the nudge card must have a descriptive accessible name: role=status + aria-live=polite. - primary CTA should be focusable and have aria-describedby if there's extra context (e.g., "Create rule. This opens the rule builder."). rachel (design): microcopy variants: - short: "No rules match your filters." - explanatory: "No rules match your filters. Clear filters or create a rule to start routing traffic." - playful (option for onboarding): "Looks quiet in here — add a rule to get routing started." dan (product): another UX point: preview area dims when no snapshot exists and some users thought it was a bug. instead, show a compact centered card: title 'No snapshot selected' then: 'Select an existing snapshot to run a preview or create one from this view.' primary action 'Select snapshot' secondary 'Create snapshot'. keep aria-modal=false so keyboard focus remains on the editor. julio (frontend): for the overlay: plan a non-modal role=dialog with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. markup sketch: ```

No snapshot selected

Select a snapshot to preview this policy. You can also create a new snapshot.

``` we'll show spinner on the primary action while fetching. card won't trap focus but will be first tabbable in the preview area. meera (a11y): minor nit: ensure Escape closes the overlay and focus returns to a sensible place (e.g., the preview button). when showing inline validation elsewhere, associate error text with the field using aria-describedby and announce via role=alert. rachel (design): reorder affordance: testers missed it in compact mode. proposal: slightly bigger hit target (24px), low-contrast by default, stronger on hover/focus. add a small sr-only hint: "Press space to pick up; arrow keys to move." show a one-time tooltip the first time a workspace opens this editor: 'Tip: drag rules to re-order or press space to use the keyboard.' dan (product): decision summary: - show compact nudge card when zero rules (rachel + julio) - reserve min-height for rules list to avoid jumps (julio) - preview overlay card instead of dim-only (julio) - live-region patterns: polite for counts, alert for blocking errors (meera) - increase reorder hit target + keyboard instructions + one-time tooltip (rachel + julio) owners: rachel (copy + mocks), julio (frontend + PR + storybook), meera (a11y signoff), dan will update the ticket and add acceptance criteria. ui-bot: snapshot job queued for branch feature/route-editor-emptyflow status: queued. julio (frontend): I'll open a small PR with storybook stories covering: empty-state card, preview-overlay, and keyboard reorder example. ETA: 48h. dan (product): great — will review PR and schedule a quick follow-up in design critique. :rocket:
